title: gentle-desk v2 - three clean directions for the Tauri client
brief: Second design round for the gentle-desk desktop client (gentle-shell GUI). Three structurally different directions, each with ONE quiet main screen (no more than about 12 visible controls, icons with tooltips instead of text buttons, no state demo controls) and the Chat | Helpers swap in the same area, shown in both views. Per-chat states live in one shared board. Same six themes as gentle-shell.

artboards.title: Shared states board
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the six per-chat states, notices, rename and delete out of the main screens so those stay silent; cost: you judge states away from the real layout.

artboards.title: A - Workspace tree (Chat view)
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to the reference: New chat, Workspace header with icons, folders with chats, independent Chats group. Familiar and complete; the tree needs vertical space and scales by search, not by structure.

artboards.title: A - Workspace tree (Helpers view)
artboards.tradeoff: Same direction with the Helpers view swapped into the same area: list on the left, thread on the right.

artboards.title: B - Activity tabs (Chat view)
artboards.tradeoff: Sidebar grouped by what needs you (Needs you, Working, Recent) with icon tabs for Workspaces and independent Chats; answers what needs me now without scanning, but old chats take one extra tab switch.

artboards.title: C - Workspace rail (Chat view)
artboards.tradeoff: A narrow rail of workspaces plus one focused chat list: the quietest, shows only one workspace at a time; the most controls on screen (13) and hidden workspaces need a click.

artboards.title: C - Workspace rail (Helpers view)
artboards.tradeoff: Same direction, Helpers view (15 controls, the densest screen).
